core_value_unit.name: independently-accepted-policy-compliant-outcome
core_value_unit.definition: A coding or reuse outcome accepted only after retrieval, provenance, contract, policy, and verification receipts satisfy the caller's declared gate.
core_value_unit.billing_rule: A rejected, abstained, timed-out, unverified, or policy-blocked attempt is never counted as a successful outcome. Infrastructure and third-party provider usage may be metered separately only when disclosed in advance.

initial_wedge.job_to_be_done: Let a coding agent find and selectively materialize organization-approved implementations without rereading whole repositories or trusting similarity as proof.
initial_wedge.buyer: engineering platform, developer productivity, application security, or AI enablement leader
initial_wedge.daily_user: developer or coding agent operating through an IDE, CLI, CI, MCP, hook, or skill
adoption_path: index one existing private repository or package portfolio
connect a search-first coding harness in advisory mode
measure retrieval, abstention, verification, latency, and accepted outcomes
enable policy-gated reuse for proven primitive families
expand to more languages, teams, and managed orchestration

meters.anti_abuse_rule: Deduplicated immutable entities count once per declared tenant scope and active projection epoch.
Content-addressed duplicates are not charged repeatedly within the contracted deduplication scope.
The receipt must disclose environment, policy, verifier, outcome, resource class, and whether the job contributed to an accepted result.
Only independently verified and policy-accepted results qualify; retries and failed attempts never count as successful outcomes.
Provider charges and any Taedri orchestration fee are separately visible; cached or skipped calls are not represented as provider usage.

differentiation: Exact identity and provenance remain independent of model-generated representations.
Search nominates; typed contracts, policy, evidence, and verification decide.
Primitive source and evidence are selectively downloadable through content-addressed thin packs.
Multiple LLMs, deterministic labelers, embeddings, sparse features, LSH families, and graph projections can compete without becoming canonical truth.
Prompt and worker receipts make quality, privacy, cost, and failure measurable across harnesses.

claim_policy.quality_claims: must name corpus, workload, policy, metric, sample size, failures, and evaluation run
claim_policy.security_claims: must name threat model, enforcement boundary, and test evidence

validation_gates.question: Do at least three design partners repeatedly use search-first private capability retrieval on real work?
Does the system improve decision-preserving retrieval over repository search and baseline semantic search?
Can verification deliver useful accepted outcomes within a sustainable latency and resource envelope?
Which workload actually requires an independently scaled or isolated service?
